subject: math
description: Connect the center, radius, and points on a circle using the center-radius form of a circle equation.
learningObjectives: Identify the center and radius in center-radius form
Explain why every point on a circle is the same distance from the center
Check whether a point lies on a circle using substitution
Connect circle graphs to equations of the form (x - h)^2 + (y - k)^2 = r^2
Distinguish the radius from the squared radius in a circle equation
prerequisites: Plotting points on the Cartesian plane
Using the distance formula or recognizing horizontal and vertical distances
